'''Beviin Verhayc''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Verhayc made a living as a craftsman, creating and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|selling]] quality [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian helmets]], including ones that could be worn by [[Youngling/Legends|children]].<ref name="O66" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the veteran Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] considered approaching Verhayc to build a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] for his young grandson, [[Venku Skirata]].<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beviin Verhayc was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the novel [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], the fourth entry in [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]]' [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]], published [[September 16]], [[2008]].<ref name="O66" />
